C0130.title: Shanghai Putuo Police Detain Woman for Fabricating Hotel Hygiene Claims
C0130.summary: In May 2025, China Police Daily reported that Shanghai Putuo police had solved a series of picking-quarrels-and-provoking-trouble cases. The suspect Wang used her own allergic condition to fabricate hotel hygiene problems and demand room-fee compensation. Police found that she had moved through more than ten hotels in Shanghai within one month and repeatedly demanded refunds on the same grounds. Wang was placed under criminal detention.

references.title: Shanghai Putuo police solve series of picking-quarrels cases; suspect detained
